_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit it. Run `honeypot2 init` to generate it interactively instead.
_realSiteTarget_comment: Where legitimate org traffic gets proxied to (your real website/app).
_trustProxyHeaders_comment: Set true ONLY if this gateway sits behind a load balancer/CDN you control, so X-Forwarded-For is trustworthy.
_orgNetworks_comment: CIDR ranges considered 'organization network'. Traffic matching one of these is proxied to realSiteTarget. Everything else is routed to the honeypot.
_orgAllowList_comment: Optional list of individual IPs (e.g. remote employees) always treated as org traffic.
_honeypotBrand_comment: Your name/brand for this tool, shown on the admin login and dashboard.
honeypotTagline: A deception gateway that separates trusted org traffic from everyone else — capturing attacker behavior, intent and geolocation in one dashboard.
_honeypotTagline_comment: Short description of what this honeypot does, shown on the admin login page.
_siteTitleDecoy_comment: Title/branding shown on the decoy page served to non-org traffic.
_companyName_comment: Shown on the decoy login page so it looks like a real internal portal. Change this to whatever fits your deployment.
_sessionSecret_comment: Used to sign the admin dashboard's login cookie. Change this to a random string before deploying.
